fields.Name: C1 -> S4.2
fields.Description: Gate G2.7 (phase 2, dataset C1, criterion S4.2): the gate decision on C1 is `keep-simple-baseline`, the reference-grade outcome (the reference's GLM beats the one-feature baseline by 0.0130 [0.0015, 0.0229] log loss and ships the GLM). C1 trains through MJAPI on its reference split (date-carved at 2024-01-01, holdout end 2025-01-01) and the check reads the gate record stored on the run; the stored GLM-versus-dummy interval is recorded, not asserted (the reference's 0.0130 is GLM versus one-feature, a different comparison). It fails when GateRules.DecideGate drops the best-baseline comparison (outcome model): the TypeScript decision then differs from the sidecar's, the run is refused as sidecar-gate-mismatch, and no gate record is stored.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: C1 on its reference split stores the gate decision keep-simple-baseline (the GLM kept).
